title.zh: 将宿务省博戈市描笼涯唐佩德罗罗德里格斯至麦地林市描笼涯多伊哈贡、唐维吉利奥冈萨雷斯、坎哈巴加特、廷多格、库尔瓦、卡普塔坦南、卡普塔坦北、波布拉雄、达安隆索德、安提波洛、马豪阿克、卡维特，以及达安班塔延市描笼涯巴卡瓦安、帕伊帕伊、比通、波布拉雄、阿古霍、塔皮隆，直至玛雅的博戈—库尔瓦—麦地林—达安班塔延—玛雅公路更名为胡安·马卡拉埃格高速公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Bogo-Curva-Medellin Daanbantayan-Maya Road, Stretching From Barangay Don Pedro Rodriguez in the City of Bogo, Traversing Through Barangays Dayhagon, Don Virgilio Gonzales, Canhabagat, Tindog, Curva, Caputatan Sur, Caputatan Norte, Poblacion, Daanlungsod, Antipolo, Mahawak and Kawit in the Municipality of Medellin, Barangays Bakhawan, Paypay, Bitoon, Poblacion, Aguho, Tapilon Up to Maya in the Municipality of Daanbantayan, All in the Province of Cebu as Juan Macaraeg Highway
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Bogo-Curva-Medellin Daanbantayan-Maya Road, Stretching From Barangay Don Pedro Rodriguez in the City of Bogo, Traversing Through Barangays Dayhagon, Don Virgilio Gonzales, Canhabagat, Tindog, Curva, Caputatan Sur, Caputatan Norte, Poblacion, Daanlungsod, Antipolo, Mahawak and Kawit in the Municipality of Medellin, Barangays Bakhawan, Paypay, Bitoon, Poblacion, Aguho, Tapilon Up to Maya in the Municipality of Daanbantayan, All in the Province of Cebu as Juan Macaraeg Highway
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Đường Bogo-Curva-Medellin Daanbantayan-Maya, kéo dài từ Barangay Don Pedro Rodriguez tại Thành phố Bogo, đi qua các Barangay Dayhagon, Don Virgilio Gonzales, Canhabagat, Tindog, Curva, Caputatan Sur, Caputatan Norte, Poblacion, Daanlungsod, Antipolo, Mahawak và Kawit tại Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Medellin, các Barangay Bakhawan, Paypay, Bitoon, Poblacion, Aguho, Tapilon đến Maya tại Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Daanbantayan, tất cả đều thuộc Tỉnh Cebu, thành Đường Cao tốc Juan Macaraeg
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อถนนโบโก–คุร์วา–เมเดลลิน–ดาอันบันตาเยน–มายา ซึ่งเริ่มจากบารังไกย์ดอนเปโดรโรดริเกซในนครโบโก ผ่านบารังไกย์ไดฮากอน ดอนวิร์จิลิโอกอนซาเลส คันฮาบากัต ตินด็อก คุร์วา คาปูตาตันซูร์ คาปูตาตันนอร์เต โปบลาซิออน ดาอันลุงโซด อันติโปโล มาฮาวก และกาวิต ในอำเภอเมเดลลิน บารังไกย์บาคาวัน เพย์เพย์ บิตูน โปบลาซิออน อากูโฮ ตาปิลอน จนถึงมายา ในอำเภอดาอันบันตาเยน ทั้งหมดอยู่ในจังหวัดเซบู เป็นทางหลวงแห่งชาติฮวนมาคาราเอก
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengganti Nama Jalan Bogo-Curva-Medellin Daanbantayan-Maya, yang Membentang dari Barangay Don Pedro Rodriguez di Kota Bogo, Melintasi Barangay Dayhagon, Don Virgilio Gonzales, Canhabagat, Tindog, Curva, Caputatan Sur, Caputatan Norte, Poblacion, Daanlungsod, Antipolo, Mahawak dan Kawit di Kota Medellin, Barangay Bakhawan, Paypay, Bitoon, Poblacion, Aguho, Tapilon Hingga Maya di Kota Daanbantayan, Semuanya di Provinsi Cebu, Menjadi Jalan Tol Juan Macaraeg
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Jalan Bogo-Curva-Medellin Daanbantayan-Maya, yang Membentang dari Barangay Don Pedro Rodriguez di Bandar Bogo, Melalui Barangay Dayhagon, Don Virgilio Gonzales, Canhabagat, Tindog, Curva, Caputatan Sur, Caputatan Norte, Poblacion, Daanlungsod, Antipolo, Mahawak dan Kawit di Bandar Medellin, Barangay Bakhawan, Paypay, Bitoon, Poblacion, Aguho, Tapilon Hingga Maya di Bandar Daanbantayan, Semuanya di Wilayah Cebu, Menjadi Lebuhraya Juan Macaraeg

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11797_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Bogo-Curva-Medellin-Daanbantayan-Maya Road, stretching Barangay Don Pedro Rodriguez in the City of Bogo, traversing though Barangays Dayhagon, Don Virgilio Gonzales, Canhabagat, Tindog, Curva, Caputatan Sur, Caputatan Norte, Poblacion, Daanlungsod, Antipolo, Mahawak and Kawit in the Municipality of Medellin, Barangays Bakhawan, Paypay, Bitoon, Poblacion, Aguho, Tapilon up to Maya in the Municipality of Daanbantayan, all in the Province of Cebu, is hereby renamed as Juan Macaraeg Highway.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
